simple.meaning: a road (as trodden ); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דֶּרֶךְ (H1870) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: דֶּרֶךְ (derek) means a road (as trodden ); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 1 49.
